notes: Focus: a timer for grading in short sessions. Start it from the card on Today or from Focus in the sidebar, on a set of papers or one of your to-dos, and the next paper with nothing finished opens. A small panel keeps the time, folds to a pill, and offers a break when the time is up. To do has Focus on this.

A daily goal in papers or minutes, set in Settings, Focus and goals. Dots, a ring in the sidebar and this week’s bars fill in as you go, and turn green when you get there. A paper counts when its score is finished or its feedback is complete.
